newsitem.title: USA: Herley to acquire Metraplex in stock swap.
newsitem.headline: Herley to acquire Metraplex in stock swap.

text.p: Herley Industries Inc said Tuesday it agreed to acquire Metraplex Corp, a privately-held manufacturer of communication data links focusing on the commercial and industrial markets.
The company said the acquisition is a stock swap that will be treated under purchase accounting regulations. The exact dollar value of the deal was not disclosed.
The company said it expects to close the deal in its present fiscal year, which ends on August 3.
The company said it does not expect there will be any good will in the non-dilutive consolidation of Metroplex.
